instruction: Inspect the assigned screenshot image and extract all visible text messages. Return valid JSON only, as one object with keys: image (assigned repository path), messages (array in visual reading order), and unreadable_regions (array). Each message object must contain author, text, timestamp, and confidence. Copy message text exactly, preserving punctuation, spelling, emoji, and meaningful line breaks. Set author to the sender name exactly as displayed when explicit; otherwise use null. Do not infer identity from bubble color, contact photos, or conversational context. Set timestamp to the visible message timestamp or null. Use confidence from 0 to 1 and explain uncertain characters in an optional note. Exclude app chrome and non-message UI text unless it is necessary to distinguish the author. Do not add text that is not visible.
